verdict.rationale: Alloy is an AML and fraud compliance platform, so preparing suspicious-activity reports is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows transaction monitoring that can 'generate alerts or investigations', but nothing documents preparing a suspicious-activity report, let alone a jurisdiction-specific one, from case evidence. Alert and investigation generation is an adjacent feature and earns no credit toward report preparation.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can prepare a jurisdiction-specific suspicious-activity report from case evidence
